name: NSF and US-Israel Binational Science Foundation (BSF)
collect_note: Grants.gov search2 for agency NSF + keyword CBET, kept only where the title is the CBET solicitation; that solicitation (NSF 26-518 today, successor numbers later) is the vehicle for the NSF-BSF joint grants, so the next CBET call appears without a new config. Grants.gov shows 2076-10-05 as the close date of rolling NOFOs, so that date is a placeholder, not a real deadline. BSF's own NSF-BSF page (bsf.org.il) and the Technion page have no dated calls and are kept as the funder url only; BSF has no public JSON or feed of calls.

sample.title: Engineering (ENG): Chemical, Bioengineering, Energy, and Transport Systems (CBET)

evidence: Plain HTTP POST https://api.grants.gov/v1/api/search2 with body {rows:25, oppStatuses:forecasted|posted, agencies:NSF, keyword:CBET} on 2026-11-12: HTTP 200, 2 hits (26-518 posted, opened 2026-08-17; 25-537 NSF-DFG lead agency, dropped by title filter). Also checked: keyword BSF, NSF 26-518 oppNum and keyword Binational/Israel returned no BSF call; NSF funding RSS (nsf.gov/rss/rss_www_funding_pgm_annc_inf.xml) HTTP 200 lists CBET only as a title match in its 15 items. Funder url https://trdf.technion.ac.il/en/calls-for-proposals/nsf-bsf-programs/ HTTP 200 (no dated calls). https://www.bsf.org.il/funding-opportunities/nsf-bsf-joint-research-grants/ HTTP 200 (no dated calls).
